H0362|options:
H0363|  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
H0364|  --model-path MODEL_PATH, --model MODEL_PATH
H0365|                        The path of the model weights. This can be a local
H0366|                        folder or a Hugging Face repo ID.
H0367|  --tokenizer-path TOKENIZER_PATH
H0368|                        The path of the tokenizer.
H0369|  --tokenizer-mode {auto,slow}
H0370|                        Tokenizer mode. 'auto' will use the fast tokenizer if
H0371|                        available, and 'slow' will always use the slow
H0372|                        tokenizer.
H0373|  --tokenizer-backend {huggingface,fastokens}
H0374|                        Tokenizer backend. 'huggingface' uses the default
H0375|                        HuggingFace tokenizers library, and 'fastokens' uses
H0376|                        the fastokens library for faster tokenization.
H0377|                        Requires the fastokens package to be installed.
H0378|  --tokenizer-worker-num TOKENIZER_WORKER_NUM
H0379|                        The worker num of the tokenizer manager.
H0380|  --detokenizer-worker-num DETOKENIZER_WORKER_NUM
H0381|                        The worker num of the detokenizer manager.
H0382|  --skip-tokenizer-init
H0383|                        If set, skip init tokenizer and pass input_ids in
H0384|                        generate request.
H0385|  --load-format {auto,pt,safetensors,npcache,dummy,sharded_state,gguf,bitsandbytes,mistral,layered,flash_rl,remote,remote_instance,fastsafetensors,private,runai_streamer}
H0386|                        The format of the model weights to load. "auto" will
H0387|                        try to load the weights in the safetensors format and
H0388|                        fall back to the pytorch bin format if safetensors
H0389|                        format is not available. "pt" will load the weights in
H0390|                        the pytorch bin format. "safetensors" will load the
H0391|                        weights in the safetensors format. "npcache" will load
H0392|                        the weights in pytorch format and store a numpy cache
H0393|                        to speed up the loading. "dummy" will initialize the
H0394|                        weights with random values, which is mainly for
H0395|                        profiling."gguf" will load the weights in the gguf
H0396|                        format. "bitsandbytes" will load the weights using
H0397|                        bitsandbytes quantization."layered" loads weights
H0398|                        layer by layer so that one can quantize a layer before
H0399|                        loading another to make the peak memory envelope
H0400|                        smaller.
H0401|  --model-loader-extra-config MODEL_LOADER_EXTRA_CONFIG
H0402|                        Extra config for model loader. This will be passed to
H0403|                        the model loader corresponding to the chosen
H0404|                        load_format.
H0405|  --trust-remote-code   Whether or not to allow for custom models defined on
H0406|                        the Hub in their own modeling files.
H0407|  --context-length CONTEXT_LENGTH
H0408|                        The model's maximum context length. Defaults to None
H0409|                        (will use the value from the model's config.json
H0410|                        instead). Supports standard SI suffixes (k, M, G, T)
H0411|                        and IEC suffixes (Ki, Mi, Gi, Ti). Suffixes are case-
H0412|                        sensitive. Decimals are allowed for SI suffixes only.
H0413|                        Examples: '1k' -> 1000 '1M' -> 1000000 '25.6k' ->
H0414|                        25600 '1Ki' -> 1024 '1Mi' -> 1048576
H0415|  --is-embedding        Whether to use a CausalLM as an embedding model.
H0416|  --prefill-only-disable-kv-cache
H0417|                        Skip the physical KV cache allocation for embedding-
H0418|                        mode prefill-only workloads. Currently only valid with
H0419|                        --is-embedding, --chunked-prefill-size=-1, --disable-
H0420|                        radix-cache, an FA prefill backend, and non-FP4 KV
H0421|                        cache so the fa_skip_kv_cache path is active (no layer
H0422|                        reads or writes the cache). Other prefill-only
H0423|                        workloads such as scoring/MIS may benefit from this
H0424|                        later once their attention paths stop using paged KV.
H0425|                        Scheduler admission accounting is unchanged; per-layer
H0426|                        K/V tensors are sized to (page_size, head_num,
H0427|                        head_dim) placeholders so GPU memory is not wasted.
H0428|  --enable-multimodal   Enable the multimodal functionality for the served
H0429|                        model. If the model being served is not multimodal,
H0430|                        nothing will happen
H0431|  --revision REVISION   The specific model version to use. It can be a branch
H0432|                        name, a tag name, or a commit id. If unspecified, will
H0433|                        use the default version.
H0434|  --model-impl MODEL_IMPL
H0435|                        Which implementation of the model to use. * "auto"
H0436|                        will try to use the SGLang implementation if it exists
H0437|                        and fall back to the Transformers implementation if no
H0438|                        SGLang implementation is available. * "sglang" will
H0439|                        use the SGLang model implementation. * "transformers"
H0440|                        will use the Transformers model * "mindspore" will use
H0441|                        the MindSpore model implementation.
H0442|  --model-config-parser MODEL_CONFIG_PARSER
H0443|                        Which model-config parser to use. "auto" picks
H0444|                        "mistral" via the is_mistral_model name heuristic,
H0445|                        else "hf" (AutoConfig over config.json). Plugins can
H0446|                        register additional parsers via
H0447|                        @register_model_config_parser.

H0481|  --dtype {auto,half,float16,bfloat16,float,float32}
H0482|                        Data type for model weights and activations. * "auto"
H0483|                        will use FP16 precision for FP32 and FP16 models, and
H0484|                        BF16 precision for BF16 models. * "half" for FP16.
H0485|                        Recommended for AWQ quantization. * "float16" is the
H0486|                        same as "half". * "bfloat16" for a balance between
H0487|                        precision and range. * "float" is shorthand for FP32
H0488|                        precision. * "float32" for FP32 precision.
H0489|  --quantization {awq,fp8,mxfp8,gptq,marlin,gptq_marlin,awq_marlin,bitsandbytes,gguf,modelopt,modelopt_fp8,modelopt_fp4,modelopt_mixed,petit_nvfp4,w8a8_int8,w8a8_fp8,moe_wna16,qoq,w4afp8,mxfp4,auto-round,compressed-tensors,modelslim,quark,quark_int4fp8_moe,mlx_q4,mlx_q8,unquant}

H0495|                        factors default to 1.0, which may cause accuracy
H0496|                        issues.

H0499|                        data type. "bf16" or "bfloat16" for BF16 KV cache.
H0500|                        "fp8_e5m2" and "fp8_e4m3" are supported for CUDA
H0501|                        11.8+. "fp4_e2m1" (only mxfp4) is supported for CUDA

H0566|                        suffixes (k, M, G, T) and IEC suffixes (Ki, Mi, Gi,

H0612|                        Used, 'slru' stands for Segmented Least Recently Used,
H0613|                        and 'priority' evicts lower-priority requests first.

H0619|  --prefill-delayer-token-usage-low-watermark PREFILL_DELAYER_TOKEN_USAGE_LOW_WATERMARK
H0620|                        Token usage low watermark for prefill delayer.
H0621|  --prefill-delayer-forward-passes-buckets PREFILL_DELAYER_FORWARD_PASSES_BUCKETS [PREFILL_DELAYER_FORWARD_PASSES_BUCKETS ...]
H0622|                        Custom buckets for prefill delayer forward passes
H0623|                        histogram. 0 and max_delay_passes-1 will be auto-
H0624|                        added.

H0626|                        Custom buckets for prefill delayer wait seconds
H0627|                        histogram. 0 will be auto-added.
H0628|  --prefill-delayer-queue-min-ratio PREFILL_DELAYER_QUEUE_MIN_RATIO
H0629|                        Opt-in to the adaptive queue-based delay trigger
H0630|                        (independent of the slot-based one). Delays prefill
H0631|                        until the waiting queue reaches min(running_req *
H0632|                        ratio, max_prefill_bs) so small fragments batch into a
H0633|                        larger prefill. Unset (default) keeps the original
H0634|                        slot-only behavior. Typical: 0.1 ~ 0.5.
H0635|  --prefill-delayer-max-delay-ms PREFILL_DELAYER_MAX_DELAY_MS
H0636|                        Wall-clock cap (ms) on a single queue-trigger delay;
H0637|                        once exceeded, prefill is force-released to bound
H0638|                        worst-case TTFT. Only consulted when --prefill-
H0639|                        delayer-queue-min-ratio is set. Typical: 1000 ~ 5000;
H0640|                        defaults to 5000 if unset.

H1369|                        If disabled (default), GC is frozen during capture to
H1370|                        speed up the process.
H1371|  --debug-cuda-graph    Enable debug/eager mode for CUDA graph using breakable
H1372|                        CUDA graph. When enabled, graph breaks are inserted so
H1373|                        every operation runs eagerly while still going through
H1374|                        the CUDA graph capture / replay path. Useful for
H1375|                        debugging CUDA graph capture / replay issues.
H1376|  --enable-layerwise-nvtx-marker
H1377|                        Enable layerwise NVTX profiling annotations for the
H1378|                        model.
H1379|  --enable-nccl-nvls    Enable NCCL NVLS for prefill heavy requests when
H1380|                        available.
H1381|  --enable-symm-mem     Enable NCCL symmetric memory for fast collectives.
H1382|  --disable-flashinfer-cutlass-moe-fp4-allgather
H1383|                        Disables quantize before all-gather for flashinfer
H1384|                        cutlass moe.
H1385|  --enable-tokenizer-batch-encode
H1386|                        Enable batch tokenization for improved performance
H1387|                        when processing multiple text inputs. Do not use with
H1388|                        image inputs, pre-tokenized input_ids, or
H1389|                        input_embeds.
H1390|  --disable-tokenizer-batch-decode

H1392|                        completions.
H1393|  --disable-outlines-disk-cache
H1394|                        Disable disk cache of outlines to avoid possible
H1395|                        crashes related to file system or high concurrency.

H1398|                        NCCL.
H1399|  --enable-mscclpp      Enable using mscclpp for small messages for all-reduce
H1400|                        kernel and fall back to NCCL.
H1401|  --enable-torch-symm-mem
H1402|                        Enable using torch symm mem for all-reduce kernel and
H1403|                        fall back to NCCL. Only supports CUDA device SM90 and
H1404|                        above. SM90 supports world size 4, 6, 8. SM100
H1405|                        supports world size 6, 8.
H1406|  --pre-warm-nccl       Pre-warm NCCL/RCCL communicators during startup to
H1407|                        reduce P99 TTFT cold-start latency. Default: enabled
H1408|                        for AMD/HIP (RCCL), disabled for NVIDIA/CUDA (NCCL).
H1409|  --disable-overlap-schedule
H1410|                        Disable the overlap scheduler, which overlaps the CPU
H1411|                        scheduler with GPU model worker.
H1412|  --enable-mixed-chunk  Enabling mixing prefill and decode in a batch when
H1413|                        using chunked prefill.
H1414|  --enable-dp-attention
H1415|                        Enabling data parallelism for attention and tensor
H1416|                        parallelism for FFN. The dp size should be equal to
H1417|                        the tp size. Currently DeepSeek-V2 and Qwen 2/3 MoE
H1418|                        models are supported.
H1419|  --enable-dp-attention-local-control-broadcast

H1421|                        group leader and broadcast within attn_tp_group
H1422|                        instead of the full tp_group. Eliminates a costly all-
H1423|                        ranks gloo sync on every scheduler iteration.
H1424|  --enable-dp-lm-head   Enable vocabulary parallel across the attention TP

H1556|                        Disable scheduler-side attn_tp_gather (the upstream SP
H1557|                        path that pads num_tokens to attn_tp_size and pre-
H1558|                        allocates a gathered buffer). Use for models that
H1559|                        manage SP scatter/gather at the model level (e.g.,
H1560|                        perform their own all_gather/reduce_scatter inside

H1564|                        kernel autotuners to select wrong-sized variants at
